_comment: Default bindings for the controller this package declares, transcribed from BizHawk's
Assets/defctrl.json ('SNES Controller'). Only player 1 is bound. The user's own

SNES Controller.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
SNES Controller.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
SNES Controller.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
SNES Controller.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
